title: Feature request: show time when BG graph is clicked
body:
In Overview tab, the very main screen of AAPS (also in History browser), when the BG graph is clicked, we can see BG value that pops up on the bottom of the screen (marked red on the first screen).
What if this value came together with the time?

I mean - the mobile displays are tiny, fingers are big, inaccuracy can be annoying.
A pair of information, i.e. the time + BG value could be really helpful.

An example of this implementation on the second screen.
